description: This file defines the PgSQL class, which provides a wrapper for PostgreSQL database operations including connection management, query execution, escaping strings, and retrieving last insert IDs within the Opencart system.

classes.name: PgSQL
classes.description: A class providing PostgreSQL database connection and query management functionalities within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection using provided options; throws exception if required parameters are missing or connection fails.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result as an object containing the fetched rows, single row, and row count.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string value for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last executed query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from a sequence, useful for insert operations.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks whether the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
